turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, how may I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: HI, i have a promo code im trying to use but it is declared invalid and i got it 5 days ago

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me help you with that.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: So your code was shown invalid even though it has been 7 days?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: hasn't

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Correct it hasn't been 7 days

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Could I have your full name or account id?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Crystal Minh

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Crystal Minh.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me check the system to see what the problem is.

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Querying the system for an answer ...

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: okay

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Could I have your membership level?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Member Level: Gold

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Membership level of Gold has been noted.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me generate a new promo code for you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: okay, thank you

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: A promo code has been created.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your new promo code is PX1CE

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, thank you

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Can I help you with anything else?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No that was everything, thank you again for all your help

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Have a good day.
